risks.if_unproven: price only the headlamp pair and grille shown; exclude any taillight value

risks.risk: Electrical/working condition unverified — bulbs, connectors, or internal reflector could be faulty.

risks.risk: Grille or headlamp fitment may not exactly match a specific Prado generation/year, affecting resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up of any OEM part number sticker/stamp on the back of the grille or headlamp housing.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, yellowing, or moisture inside the lens not visible from this angle/lighting.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each lens from multiple angles in daylight, including the inside via the bulb socket.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual taillight unit(s), since none are shown
Short video of each headlamp powered on to confirm 'working condition'
Close-up of any part number or Prado-specific marking on the grille and headlamp backs

response.reason: No comparable listings were provided for this kind of item, and the seller's own description does not match what the photos show (taillight claimed, headlamps pictured), so even a worst-case price cannot be set without matching comparables.
